content: Generate a U-shaped profile by subtracting an offset rectangular box from a larger one, ensuring both ends remain open. The larger box should measure 450 mm in length, 70 mm in width, and 40 mm in height. Subtract an inner box that is 60 mm wide and 35 mm and high with same 450mm length, maintain a wall thickness of 5 mm around the sides and base, resulting in a U-shape, open at the top and sides | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the dimensions and positions for the U-shaped profile\\n\\n# Outer box dimensions\\nouter_length = 450\\nouter_width = 70\\nouter_height = 40\\n\\n# Inner box dimensions (subtracted)\\ninner_width = 60\\ninner_height = 35\\ninner_length = 450  # Same as outer length\\n\\n# Wall thickness\\nwall_thickness = 5\\n\\n# Calculate the position of the inner box to maintain wall thickness\\n# The inner box is centered in the outer box, with 5mm walls on the sides and bottom\\nx_position_inner = wall_thickness\\ny_position_inner = wall_thickness\\nz_position_inner = wall_thickness\\n\\n# The inner box should be subtracted from the outer box\\nsubtraction = [False, True]\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"outer_length\\\": outer_length,\\n    \\\"outer_width\\\": outer_width,\\n    \\\"outer_height\\\": outer_height,\\n    \\\"inner_width\\\": inner_width,\\n    \\\"inner_height\\\": inner_height,\\n    \\\"inner_length\\\": inner_length,\\n    \\\"x_position_inner\\\": x_position_inner,\\n    \\\"y_position_inner\\\": y_position_inner,\\n    \\\"z_position_inner\\\": z_position_inner,\\n    \\\"subtraction\\\": subtraction\\n}\"}"

content:
{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions and positions for the U-shaped profile

# Outer box dimensions
outer_length = 450
outer_width = 70
outer_height = 40

# Inner box dimensions (subtracted)
inner_width = 60
inner_height = 35
inner_length = 450  # Same as outer length

# Wall thickness
wall_thickness = 5

# Calculate the position of the inner box to maintain wall thickness
# The inner box is centered in the outer box, with 5mm walls on the sides and bottom
x_position_inner = wall_thickness
y_position_inner = wall_thickness
z_position_inner = wall_thickness

# The inner box should be subtracted from the outer box
subtraction = [False, True]

# Return the calculated values
{
    "outer_length": outer_length,
    "outer_width": outer_width,
    "outer_height": outer_height,
    "inner_width": inner_width,
    "inner_height": inner_height,
    "inner_length": inner_length,
    "x_position_inner": x_position_inner,
    "y_position_inner": y_position_inner,
    "z_position_inner": z_position_inner,
    "subtraction": subtraction
}"}
